value.rationale: The exact n-dependent root weight optimizes covariance between local branching and global leaf production in a classic weighted tree-growth model. The unique peak at theta=n-2 equals (n-1)/8, of order n, even though fixed theta gives only bounded covariance. The weight-scale transition and sharp optimum are motivated structural dependence information not supplied by either marginal distribution.
